name: 36849 · Auburn, AL
findings: ZIP 36849 (Auburn) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
88% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 36849 (Auburn) has 33 organizations listing opportunities online, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

confidence.text: Based on 62 organizations here; 92% of all organizations here have no identified type.
